en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, form Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hafs Bin Al Bakhtary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The original pigeon of the Sanctuary of the rest of the pigeons was for Ismail<sup>as</sup> Bin Ibrahim<sup>as</sup>. He<sup>as</sup> took it as he<sup>as</sup> was comfortable with it’.
So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is recommended for you to take a clipped bird to be comfortable with it, if fear of the vermin’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtariy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The real free pigeon remaining is the pigeon that belonged to Tsma‘il ibn Ibrahim, ‘Alayhima al-Salam, who kept it for comfort.
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘It is preferable to keep a bird with clipped wings for comfort and for (to dispel) fear from vermin.’”
